Baleful Shadow Transmutation.descriptionOnly: no path: the +4 on saves against it in an ill-suited form is the target's save against the spell; its form's numbers are told here

First World Revisions.descriptionOnly: the loss of darkvision and the rest of ancestral regression are told here

choices.label: Ignoble Form: Craft, Knowledge, Perform or Profession
Ignoble Form: the specialty (local, alchemy, sing, ...)

Ignoble Form.descriptionOnly: no path: its +3 racial is on the Craft, Knowledge, Perform or Profession skill it picks, written by the pick; the loss of darkvision, light blindness and light sensitivity is told here

Masochistic Shadow.descriptionOnly: no path: the +2 and –2 on Reflex saves against it, in bright light and in darkness, are the target's saves against the spell; its 1d4 Strength damage is rolled at the table

Penumbral Disguise.descriptionOnly: not in bright light; the vagueness of its appearance in dim light or darkness is told here

Spotlight.descriptionOnly: it also takes the penalties of bright light and has no concealment from darkness, as with faerie fire

Umbral Infusion.descriptionOnly: the advanced creature template; its +2 to special ability DCs and 2 hit points per Hit Die are told here
